title: Live: College GameDay
description: Originating from the site of one of the day's best matchups, with a sea of fans cheering wildly in the background, host Rece Davis and analysts Lee Corso, Kirk Herbstreit and Desmond Howard talk college football for three hours, reporting on the top teams, games, players and storylines. David Pollack and Maria Taylor contribute reports, interviews and features. Davis replaced longtime host Chris Fowler in 2015.

title: Live: College Football
description: The No. 7 Hurricanes (8-1, 6-0 ACC) try to recover as they host the Blue Devils (7-2, 4-2). Miami, which is without star wideout Malachi Toney, lost 31-24 at Notre Dame last week. Duke has won three straight after dismantling NC State, 41-3.

title: Live: College Football
description: The No. 1 Georgia Bulldogs (8-1, 6-1 SEC) host the No. 22 Missouri Tigers (6-3, 3-3 SEC) at Sanford Stadium. Georgia aims for a three-game win streak behind quarterback Gunner Stockton, while Missouri hopes to bounce back after 34-20 loss to Texas.

description: The Atlanta Falcons host the Kansas City Chiefs in NFL regular-season play at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Atlanta enters at 3-6 after four losses in its last five games, while Kansas City arrives at 6-2 following a 35-12 victory over the New York Jets.
